verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This work aims at further investigations on the work of Giambruno and Restivo to find the rank of the intersection of two finitely generated submonoids of a free monoid. In this connection, we obtain the rank of a finitely generated submonoid of a free monoid that is accepted by semi-flower automaton with two bpi's. verdicts.title: Koszulity of dual braid monoid algebras via cluster complexes
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The dual braid monoid was introduced by Bessis in his work on complex reflection arrangements. The goal of this work is to show that Koszul duality provides a nice interplay between the dual braid monoid and the cluster complex introduced by Fomin and Zelevinsky. verdicts.title: Principal ideals in a plactic monoid always intersect
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This note presents a proof that two principal ideals in a plactic monoid always intersect. Namely, this means that the plactic monoids are both left and right reversible. To the author's knowledge, this result has not yet appeared in the literature studying this monoid. This result holds for both finite rank plactic monoids and the infinite rank plactic monoid.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns intersection of principal ideals in plactic monoids (a reversibility result), which shares only the broad 'monoid' vocabulary with the conjecture and does not address braided monoid automorphisms, CNF formulas, or communication complexity rank variance.
